fullPassage:
Samoa is a Polynesian island country, consisting of two main islands (Upolu and Savai'i), located in the South Pacific. It is known for its year-round warm tropical weather, stunning beaches, and gorgeous waterfalls. Samoa even served as one of the sources of inspiration for the directors of the movie Moana released in 2016. It is a stunning island country that preserves its traditions, history, and distinct way of life.
A "fale" is a traditional Samoan house, with round-shaped thatched huts, supported by wood columns, but with no walls. The architecture of fale is very well-suited to the Samoan tropical climate. Its open-sided structure not only allows air to circulate freely to keep the space cool but also allows strong winds to pass through, enabling it to resist extreme weather events. The unique structure of the fale mirrors the Samoan people's values of openness and community. Its open structure allows people to come and go freely, creating a sense of belonging.
Samoa and American Samoa are different countries, even though they are next to each other in the South Pacific Ocean. Although these two countries used to be in the same time zone, the situation completely changed in 2011. On December 29, 2011, Samoans skipped December 30, and went straight to December 31, jumping 24 hours into the future. This happened because the Samoan government decided to switch sides of the International Date Line. This was to align the time with New Zealand, Australia, and other Asian countries, to improve their business transactions. Samoa is now on the opposite side of the International Date Line from American Samoa. They are just half an hour apart by flight, but there is a 24-hour time difference between them. If you fly from Samoa to American Samoa, in about 30 minutes you will return to yesterday!

questions.passage: Samoa is a Polynesian island country, (A)[consisting / composing] of two main islands (Upolu and Savai'i), located in the South Pacific. It is known for its year-round warm (B)[tropical / freezing] weather, stunning beaches, and gorgeous waterfalls. Samoa even served as one of the sources of inspiration for the directors of the movie Moana released in 2016. It is a stunning island country that preserves its traditions, history, and (C)[distinct / unique] way of life.
questions.stem: (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 두 개의 본섬으로 구성된(consisting), 열대(tropical) 기후, 독특한(distinct) 삶의 방식.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ consisting–tropical–distinct: 모두 원문 그대로
❌ ① unique는 문맥상 가능하나 원문은 distinct
❌ ② freezing(매우 추운)은 열대 기후와 모순
❌ ④ composing은 자동사로 'of'와 결합 불가
det.tip: consist of = ~로 구성되다 (자동사) / compose는 타동사로 be composed of 형태 / distinct ≈ unique이지만 원문 기준

questions.passage: A "fale" is a traditional Samoan house, with round-shaped thatched huts, supported by wood columns, but with no walls. The architecture of fale is very (A)[well-suited / unsuitable] to the Samoan tropical climate. Its open-sided structure not only allows air to (B)[circulate / accumulate] freely to keep the space cool but also allows strong winds to pass through, enabling it to (C)[resist / attract] extreme weather events.
questions.stem: (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 팔레의 건축 양식은 사모아 열대 기후에 매우 적합하다(well-suited). 공기가 자유롭게 순환(circulate)하고 극한 날씨를 견딜 수(resist) 있다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① well-suited–circulate–resist: 모두 원문 적합
❌ ② accumulate(축적하다)는 공기 순환과 반대
❌ ③ unsuitable(부적합한)은 문맥 모순
❌ ④ attract(끌어들이다)는 극한 날씨를 견디는 것과 반대
det.tip: well-suited to = ~에 적합한 / circulate(순환하다) ↔ accumulate(축적하다) / resist(저항하다) ↔ attract(끌어들이다)

questions.passage: Although these two countries used to be in the same time zone, the situation completely changed in 2011. On December 29, 2011, Samoans skipped December 30, and went straight to December 31, jumping 24 hours into the future. This happened because the Samoan government decided to (A)[switch / maintain] sides of the International Date Line. This was to (B)[align / disrupt] the time with New Zealand, Australia, and other Asian countries, to (C)[improve / hinder] their business transactions.
questions.stem: (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 정부가 날짜 변경선의 반대쪽으로 바꾸기로(switch) 결정했다. 시간을 맞추기(align) 위해, 사업 거래를 개선하기(improve) 위해.
det.analysis:
✅ ② switch–align–improve: 모두 원문 적합
❌ ① hinder(방해하다)는 improve의 반의어
❌ ③ maintain(유지하다)은 상황이 '완전히 바뀌었다'는 문맥과 모순
❌ ④ disrupt(방해하다)는 align의 반의어
det.tip: switch sides = 편을 바꾸다 / align with = ~에 맞추다 / improve ↔ hinder(방해하다)

det.korean: 옆이 개방된 구조는 공기가 자유롭게 순환(circulate)하게 해 공간을 시원하게 유지한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① circulate(순환하다): 공기가 자유롭게 흐른다 → 시원함 유지 인과관계
❌ ② stagnate(정체하다): 공기 정체는 시원함과 반대
❌ ③ condense(응축하다): 과학 용어, 문맥 부적합
❌ ④ evaporate(증발하다): 공기가 증발하지 않음
det.tip: circulate(순환하다) ↔ stagnate(정체하다) / air circulates freely = 공기가 자유롭게 순환하다

questions.passage: The architecture of fale is very well-suited to the Samoan tropical climate. questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 열린 구조는 사람들이 자유롭게 오고 갈 수 있어 소속감(belonging)을 형성한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② belonging(소속감): openness와 community 맥락에서 소속감 형성 자연스러움
❌ ① isolation(고립): openness와 반대
❌ ③ competition(경쟁): community 가치와 반대
❌ ④ anxiety(불안): 자유롭게 오가는 것과 반대
det.tip: a sense of belonging = 소속감 / openness(개방성) + community(공동체) → belonging(소속감)

questions.passage: It is known for its year-round warm tropical weather, <u>stunning</u> beaches, and gorgeous waterfalls. Samoa even served as one of the sources of inspiration for the directors of the movie Moana.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 stunning과 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: 멋진(stunning) 바닷가.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ beautiful(아름다운): stunning의 동의어
❌ ① ugly(못생긴): 반의어
❌ ② ordinary(평범한): stunning은 '놀라울 만큼 아름다운'
❌ ④ dangerous(위험한): 무관
det.tip: stunning ≈ beautiful ≈ gorgeous ≈ breathtaking / stunning ↔ ugly, plain

det.korean: 팔레의 독특한 구조는 사모아인들의 가치를 반영한다(mirrors).
det.analysis:
✅ ④ reflects(반영하다): mirrors의 동의어, 둘 다 '비추다/반영하다'
❌ ① conceals(감추다): 반의어
❌ ② distorts(왜곡하다): 반의어
❌ ③ contradicts(모순되다): 반의어
det.tip: mirror(동사) ≈ reflect = 반영하다 / mirror ↔ conceal(감추다)

questions.passage: Its open-sided structure not only allows air to circulate freely to keep the space cool but also allows strong winds to pass through, enabling it to <u>resist</u> extreme weather events. questions.stem: 밑줄 친 resist와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: 극한 날씨를 견디다(resist).
det.analysis:
✅ ① withstand(견디다): resist의 동의어
❌ ② welcome(환영하다): 극한 날씨를 환영하지 않음
❌ ③ create(만들다): 무관
❌ ④ attract(끌어들이다): 반의어
det.tip: resist ≈ withstand ≈ endure = 견디다, 저항하다

questions.passage: The unique structure of the fale mirrors the Samoan people's values of <u>openness</u> and community. Its open structure allows people to come and go freely, creating a sense of belonging.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 openness와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: 개방성(openness)의 반의어.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ secrecy(비밀, 은밀함): openness(개방성)의 반의어
❌ ① closedness: 존재하는 단어이나 일반적이지 않음
❌ ② friendliness(친절함): openness와 유사
❌ ④ kindness(친절함): 무관
det.tip: openness(개방성) ↔ secrecy(비밀, 폐쇄성) / open ↔ secret, closed

questions.passage: This happened because the Samoan government decided to switch sides of the International Date Line. This was to align the time with New Zealand, Australia, and other Asian countries, to <u>improve</u> their business transactions.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 improve와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: 사업 거래를 개선하다(improve)의 반의어.
det.analysis:

❌ ① maintain(유지하다): 개선도 악화도 아님
❌ ③ enhance(향상시키다): improve의 동의어
❌ ④ develop(발전시키다): improve의 유사어
det.tip: improve(개선하다) ↔ worsen(악화시키다) / improve ≈ enhance, develop

questions.passage:
(A) Samoa even <u>served</u> as one of the sources of inspiration for the directors of the movie Moana released in 2016. It is a stunning island country.

(B) This happened because the Samoan government decided to switch <u>sides</u> of the International Date Line. This was to align the time with New Zealand and Australia.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 served와 sides의 의미로 알맞은 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) 영감의 원천 역할을 했다(served as). (B) 날짜 변경선의 편(sides)을 바꾸기로.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ 봉사하다/역할을 하다–편: (A) served as = ~의 역할을 하다, (B) sides = 편, 측면
❌ ① 제공하다–옆면: served의 의미와 sides의 의미 모두 부정확
❌ ② 봉사하다–옆면: sides는 물리적 옆면이 아닌 추상적 '편'
❌ ③ 제공하다–편: served as는 '제공하다'보다 '역할을 하다'
det.tip: serve as = ~의 역할을 하다 / switch sides = 편을 바꾸다 / side: 옆면, 편, 측면 등 다의어

det.korean: 이는 사모아의 시간을 뉴질랜드, 호주, 다른 아시아 나라들에 맞추기 위함이었다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① to align the time with NZ, Australia, and Asian countries: 원문 그대로, 사업 거래 개선 목적
❌ ② larger time gap: 반대로 시차를 줄이려는 것
❌ ③ attract tourists: 관광객 유치 언급 없음
❌ ④ celebrate calendar year: 달력 축하 무관
det.tip: align with = ~에 맞추다 / to improve business transactions = 사업 거래를 개선하기 위해
